title: Dynamical stability and multifunctional properties of Ni2+/Pr3+ co-doped CsPbCl3 perovskite: insights from first-principles lattice dynamics and carrier transport
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,55-75
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07356A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sikander Azam, Asif Zaman, Qaiser Rafiq, Amin Ur Rahman, Saleem Ayaz Khan
First-principles analysis shows that Ni2+/Pr3+ co-doping in CsPbCl3 suppresses soft phonon modes, enhances elastic stability, tunes band edges via d–f interactions, and improves optical absorption and carrier transport.
